# Luxe Development

> Luxury custom home builder and design-build renovation contractor serving Lemont, Illinois and Chicago's western suburbs. "Architectural Curation. Uncompromising Craft."

Luxe Development designs, engineers, and builds custom homes and high-end renovations with one accountable team — no hand-offs between architect, engineer, and builder. Founder-led (Tom Naglak). Rated 5.0 on Google.

## The Luxe Method
1. Vision & Architecture — discovery, site study, architectural and structural design
2. Bespoke Curation — materials, finishes, and an itemized, fixed budget
3. Master Construction — in-house structural execution with on-site aesthetic supervision
4. White-Glove Handover — a finished home, walked, documented, and delivered as drawn

## Services
- New Construction (ground-up custom homes — architecture, engineering, and construction)
- Home Additions (second stories, wings, expansions)
- Luxury Remodeling
- Interior Remodeling
- Interior Makeover
- Interior Design
- Exterior Design
- Luxury Kitchen Remodeling
- Luxury Bathroom Remodeling

## Service Area
Lemont (HQ), Hinsdale, Oak Brook, Burr Ridge, Naperville, Western Springs, Clarendon Hills, Downers Grove, Darien, Elmhurst, Glen Ellyn, La Grange, and 20+ western and southwest Chicago suburbs across DuPage, Cook, and Will County.
